title: Consolidation documentaire des campagnes et paquet Owner

target.source_change_policy: Resolve final documentation/evidence commit and hashes before consolidation; this manifest cannot self-bind its containing commit.

campaign_dependencies: WP12-5 if Owner requires performance characterization
scope.scientific_boundary: Index and evaluate evidence/status only; no new solve/test/benchmark and no automatic close or promotion.
required_contracts: all approved campaign manifests and run receipts

inputs: run receipts and raw evidence inventories
source_and_test_identity.hash_policy: Recompute document and artifact hashes; never edit or re-archive historical source evidence.

fixtures.policy: No scientific fixtures or solver inputs; only immutable evidence files are inventoried.

commands.command: Validate approved JSON/TSV and all cited paths/links without imports or collection

acceptance: Every verdict ties to exact commit/tree and immutable artifacts.
Failures, skips, NOT_RUN and ambiguity remain visible.
A recommendation is submitted to Owner; no status is modified here.

environment.os: Not applicable for static consolidation; record tool versions if used.

attempt_policy.correction_policy: Any documentary correction is a new versioned edit; preserve prior evidence and rerun only documentary validation.

evidence.partial_run_policy: Never change a scientific status from an incomplete evidence inventory.

notes: This is a future consolidation plan only; no tests, calculations or status decisions performed.

changes: made prospective identity resolution conditions explicit

resolve_only_after: required campaign receipts and raw evidence inventories received
identity_resolution_conditions.no_self_binding: The final WP12-6 manifest cannot include the commit containing its own final contents; record the final target as a detached external decision binding after manifest freeze.
